description: This Java class 'NoteController' defines REST API endpoints for managing notes, including create, retrieve, list, update, and delete operations, using Spring Boot annotations and integrations with other service and DTO classes.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: Controller class providing REST endpoints for notes management, including create, retrieve, update, list, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided request body and returns the created note with a 201 status.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves and returns a note by its ID.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Returns a list of notes belonging to a specified user, ordered by last update descending.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with the data from the request body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID for a given user.
